title: Proof of existence of hadrons
html: The proton \mathfrak{p} = \mathcal{B}_3(\mathfrak{u}, \mathfrak{u}, \mathfrak{d}) (categorical proton) provides a witness hadron. Its crossing energy is negative at the substrate value q_0. LP-stability analysis on the Hecke basis confirms this. The Borromean braid \mathcal{B}_3 combined with gluon stabilization ensures \mathfrak{E}_{\mathrm{cross}}(\mathfrak{p}) < 0. Similar constructions yield the neutron \mathfrak{n} and other hadrons. \square
heading: Proof
